name: Maple Wars
storyline: Step into the boots of Benny Shoemaker, a down-and-out Vermont farmer, and embark on a syrup-fueled journey across the fictional Pikatik Valley along the Vermont-Quebec border. Figure out how to heal your blighted maple farm, rally fellow New Englanders, and take the fight to the elitist Canadian Maple Syrup Syndicate. Along the way, you'll explore a variety of hand-crafted levels, meet eccentric characters, and complete satirical missions that blend exploration, problem-solving, and light combat. Solve sticky puzzles, battle hostile Canadians and their woodland allies, and prove your patriotism in the ultimate sticky showdown. Your goal? Make your President proud and drain the sappy swamp!
summary: Maple Wars is a comedy-packed adventure RPG where you play as a patriotic American maple syrup farmer down on his luck, downtrodden, and down to invade Canada. Embark on missions to fix up your farm, recruit fellow New Englanders, and sabotage the Maple Syrup Deep State. Make America Sticky Again!
